- Changed paths match the Issue's scope:

## Reproducible evidence

- PR head SHA tested (use the actual SHA, not merely HEAD):
- Main SHA included in that test:
- Commands / acceptance steps and actual results:
- Not tested and why:

For documentation-only changes, state that explicitly. Passing document checks is not evidence of application readiness.

## Author handoff

- [ ] All intended edits are committed and pushed; no secrets or personal tool configuration included.
- [ ] Current main is integrated and relevant checks have been run.
- [ ] Ready for review; branch edits will pause while the integration lead reviews.

The integration lead records their decision, tested SHAs and final main verification in a PR comment. New commits or a moving main invalidate stale review evidence. Only the active integration lead/delegated agent performs the squash merge.
